text_format.purpose: Selects the structural format of generated text.

enum_descriptions.plain: A single run of plain text.

max_lines.purpose: Strict estimated maximum number of rendered lines available for all generated items combined. Generated content must never exceed this capacity; shorten or compact it until it fits.

estimated_chars_per_line.purpose: Estimated number of characters that fit on one rendered line. Use it together with max_lines to keep generated content within the available space.

min_chars.purpose: Strict minimum number of characters across all generated items. Generated content must contain at least this many characters in total.

max_chars.purpose: Strict maximum number of characters across all generated items. Generated content must never exceed this total.

min_items.purpose: Minimum number of semantic items the generated items array must contain.

max_items.purpose: Strict maximum number of semantic items the generated items array may contain. Generated content must never exceed it; shorten or compact the item list until it fits. Items may wrap across estimated lines.

min_chars_per_item.purpose: Strict minimum number of characters in every generated item.

max_chars_per_item.purpose: Strict maximum number of characters in every generated item. Generated content must shorten each item until it fits.

target_items.purpose: Preferred number of semantic items. Treat this as guidance while always respecting min_items, max_items, and the shared line capacity.

expected_content_schema.description: Expected AI output for a text component.
